visual_action: Four young adults stand in a row on a street with the U.S. Capitol building in the background, posing as if in a video game. On-screen text reads 'CHOOSE YOUR CHARACTER'. The video then cuts to each person individually, presenting them as a character archetype: a young Black woman with an 'I Voted' sticker is 'the first-time voter'; a young man with a clipboard and a tote bag reading 'ELECT DEMS' is 'the canvasser'; a young woman in a t-shirt about reproductive rights is 'the reproductive rights activist'; and a young man in a t-shirt with rainbow lettering is 'the prideful voter'.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The video was posted by the @democrats account and features multiple people wearing or carrying merchandise with phrases like 'ELECT DEMS', 'DEMOCRAT', and the democrats.org URL.

cast.name: Unnamed first-time voter
cast.evidence: A young Black woman is shown with the on-screen text 'the first-time voter 🥺'.

cast.name: Unnamed canvasser
cast.evidence: A young man is shown with the on-screen text 'the canvasser 🗳️'.

cast.name: Unnamed reproductive rights activist
cast.evidence: A young woman is shown with the on-screen text 'the reproductive rights activist 💙'.

cast.name: Unnamed prideful voter
cast.evidence: A young man is shown with the on-screen text 'the prideful voter 🏳️‍🌈'.

on_screen_text.text: REPRODUCTIVE RIGHTS ARE ON THE BALLOT

spoken_summary: A male voice says, "Choose your character" at the beginning. The rest of the video is instrumental music.
audio_music: The video opens with a voiceover saying 'Choose your character,' immediately followed by an upbeat, retro, electronic music track reminiscent of a video game. The music continues throughout the clip, creating an energetic and playful mood.
editing_pacing: The editing uses quick cuts between a group shot and individual static character portraits, mimicking the style of a video game character selection screen.
cultural_references: The entire format of the video is a reference to the 'Choose Your Character' meme, which originates from character selection screens in fighting video games like Super Smash Bros.
The audio track, 'ChooseYourCharacter' by Jim Walter, is a popular sound used for this specific meme format on TikTok.
central_claim: The Democratic party is a diverse coalition of energized young activists and voters.
intended_effect: To make young voters feel seen and energized, and to associate the Democratic party with a diverse, inclusive, and modern movement.
